records.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path"),root=p.join(require("os").homedir(),"Movies/OpenCut Accounts"); for(const d of ["identity","data"]) {let q=p.join(root,d); console.log(d,fs.existsSync(q)?fs.readdirSync(q).length:"missing"); if(d==="identity" && fs.existsSync(q)) for(const f of fs.readdirSync(q).filter(x=>x.endsWith(".json"))) {try {let a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(q,f))); console.log(JSON.stringify({login:a.login,displayName:a.displayName,id:a.id}));}catch(e){console.log("unreadable identity",e.code||e.message)}}}'
